name: iii 0.11.2
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(engine+sdk): route OTEL telemetry to dedicated /otel endpoint by @andersonleal in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/1492
* ci(release): diff release notes against last stable, ignoring prereleases by @ytallo in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/1503
* fix(iii-worker): strip setuid/setgid bits during OCI layer extraction by @andersonleal in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/1515
* ci: improve PR checklist-checker error messages and loosen license regex by @ytallo in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/1516
* ci(release): fix release-iii checkout tag/SHA refspec collision by @ytallo in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/1517
* fix(engine): honor function_registration_prefix on function.unregister (#1508) by @ytallo in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/1511


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/compare/iii/v0.11.1...iii/v0.11.2
